intro.description: I build from first principles — from writing zero-dependency neural frameworks in Java to formulating linear-time attention for high-luminosity particle tracking at CERN. Across KindSynapse and Elixpo, I develop architectures that prioritize computational efficiency, transparency, and accessible edge deployment.
highlights: ARGUS in EPJ web of conference

websiteSection.designedBy: This portfolio is part of the Elixpo project ecosystem, built to connect open-source software, reproducible physics/AI research, and community communication in one public surface.
websiteSection.futurePlans: I am expanding research into sub-1-bit diffusion networks, verified neural caching for real-time agents, and hardware-accelerated matrix operations on commodity CPUs.
websiteSection.codeStory: Working across Elixpo alongside Ayushman Bhattacharya, Vivek Yadav, and the community has been an exceptional experience in engineering systems that are open, robust, and empirically verified.

techSection.heading: THE TECHY SYNAPSE
techSection.description: My research centers on 1-bit weight quantization, sparse and linear-complexity vision transformers, distributed vector caching, and CPU-only neural inference. I focus on removing hardware compute barriers so state-of-the-art models execute seamlessly on edge devices.
